events.title: Beta 0.6.0: Active mutations are here
events.summary: Active vs Passive mutation skillsMutations are no longer passive, and all of them have both an active and a passive effect. The active effect can be triggered when you want, with a cooldown based on each as well as the instability level, the passive effect always is on. This also comes with up to 4 hotkeys in the UI to use them, as many as mutations your body can hold -by default- at any given time:Balancing food, injectors, and hunger Food now takes twice as long to move to each freshness stage

events.title: Ad Iterum demo is out now!
events.summary: After eight months of development, Demo is OUT now! Collapsing floors, gas vents, toxic traps, alarms that call the whole floor down on you, and corpses that were rigged to explode. Fire spreads. Oil ignites. Deep water hides things... the dungeon wants you dead. Enemies roll their own modifiers: Berserk, Poisonous, Elite, Infested, Oversized, Immortal... the same creature is never quite the same fight twice. events.title: Beta 0.3.6 - Endgame: Multiple mutations, cloud saves, and endings unlocked.
events.summary: While the beta 3 play test was running, I kept working on the next milestone. Public demo is getting closer, so keep an eye open.Endings unlockedThe game had no ending! ... till now. Two of the game's endings are now actually reachable, if you've been wondering what's at the end of the run, now's a good time to push for it in the dev-experimental branch. Your decisions matter.Progress that sticksSaves now carry across versions. No more losing settings and progress every time I push a new build.

events.title: Beta 1 recap. Your deaths were not in vain
events.summary: Hi everyone! The first beta of Ad Iterum wrapped up last week, and I wanted to share what came out of it.20 players jumped in. You explored over 1700 tiles per run on average, fought through nearly 19 enemies per session, and 95% of you hit retry immediately after dying.
